info.title: ZONOS3 HTTP API
info.description:
The HTTP API of both ZONOS3 servers: the CUDA server (`servers/sgl`, `python -m zonos3_sgl`) and the ggml server
(`servers/ggml`, `zonos3-server`). The native API lives under `/v2/`; the OpenAI-compatible routes stay under
`/v1/`. Every other path belongs to Zonos Voice Studio.

**Studio serving rule.** It applies to requests whose path matches no API route (the servers register it after
every API route).
- `GET|HEAD /` returns the studio's `index.html` (the page that offers the Voice Studio and the lite page) with
  `Cache-Control: no-store, max-age=0`. A missing `index.html` is a 404
  `{"detail": "The studio is not built (pnpm --dir studio build)."}`.
- `GET|HEAD /<path>` returns the file `<studio dir>/<path>` when it resolves inside the studio dir and is a
  file; else the page `<studio dir>/<path>.html` when that is a file (`/studio` is `studio.html`, the Voice
  Studio; `/lite` is `lite.html`); otherwise a 404 `{"detail": "Not Found"}`. The file's path inside the studio dir
  picks its cache header: under `assets/` (content-hashed) `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`;
  a page (`*.html`), `sw.js` or `manifest.webmanifest` `Cache-Control: no-store, max-age=0`; any other file
  (icons, the in-browser engine, `theme-boot.js`) `Cache-Control: no-cache`.
- Paths under `/v1/` and `/v2/` are never served from the studio dir. There is no SPA fallback (the studio routes
  with the URL hash). Any other method on such a path is a 404 `{"detail": "Not Found"}`.

**Status codes.** Anything expressible in a request schema (types, enums, ranges, required and unknown fields) is
a 422 `ValidationError`. State- or semantics-dependent errors (unknown voice, a feature this server or checkpoint
lacks, a CFG combination, LACI without heads, `stream: true` with `format: "wav"`, ...) are a 400 `Error`.
Unknown resources on resource paths are a 404. Project errors may add `missing`, `revision` or `sha256` to the
`Error` body.

**Sessions.** `X-TTS-Session-ID` scopes the speaker cache: `POST /v2/speakers` writes into the session, and
`GET /v2/speakers` and every `speaker_*_id` field read the session's voices (default voices are always visible).

**Keepalive.** `X-Keepalive: 1` on `POST /v2/edit`, `/v2/edit/transcribe`, `/v2/edit/align` and the POST paths a
plugin lists answers 200 at once with `x-keepalive: 1`, sends a space byte every 10 s while the request runs, then
the JSON body (leading whitespace is valid JSON). An error arrives in that body as
`{"detail": ..., "status_code": <status>}`.

**Access.** When the server runs with `ZONOS3_ACCESS_TOKEN`, every request needs the token: `Authorization:
Bearer <token>`, the HttpOnly cookie `zonos3_access`, or once `GET /?access_token=<token>`, which answers 303 to
`/` and sets that cookie. A failure is a 403 `text/plain` `Access denied`. Then `/v2/media/*` successes carry
`Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable`, every other response `Cache-Control: no-store`, and all
responses `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`.

**CORS.** Every origin is allowed (`*`); the exposed response headers are `X-Audio-Sample-Rate`,
`X-Audio-Channels`, `X-Audio-Format`, `X-Control-Span-Follow` and `X-Seed`.

**Plugins.** A server started with `--plugins N...` mounts each plugin's routes (listed in
`Capabilities.plugins`). Plugin `N` serves only `/v2/N/*` and `/N`, `/N/*` (ahead of the studio serving rule);
those paths are documented in the plugin's own repository, e.g. https://github.com/Zyphra/ZONOS3-dub.

post.description:
`pcm` streams raw float32 PCM; `wav` is buffered. A non-null `voice` must be a speaker id of
`GET /v2/speakers` and is used as `speaker_embedding_id` (unknown: 400 `unknown voice '<v>'`); it cannot be
combined with any `speaker_*` input field (400).

`format: "pcm"` returns float32 little-endian mono PCM at 44100 Hz, chunked when `stream` is true.
`format: "wav"` returns a buffered 16-bit PCM mono WAV (samples clipped to [-1, 1]) and needs
`stream: false` (else 400). `X-Seed` echoes the seed used (drawn uniformly in 0..2^31-1 when `seed` is null).
`X-Control-Span-Follow` says which schedule placed `control_spans` (`rate` or `reading`) and is sent when
`control_spans` is set.

get.summary: Feature flags of the loaded checkpoint and server
Default voices and the session's cached voices

post.summary: Cache a voice in the session
post.description:
Exactly one of `speaker_audio_base64` (a clip) or `speaker_embedding_base64` (a `.npy`/`.npz` embedding) is
required (else 400). `X-TTS-Session-ID` is required (400 without it).

post.summary: Gold-lexicon IPA for the words of a text
post.description:
With `guess`, espeak-ng fills ambiguous and unknown words of the `phonemize_guess_languages`. On a
phoneme-token checkpoint, a pronunciation with a symbol outside its inventory is returned as `unsupported`
with no `ipa`. 404 when the server has no lexicon.

200.description: Segments whose texts concatenate to the input.

post.summary: Qwen3-ASR transcript of the audio to edit and its FuseAlign word timings
post.description:
Needs speech recognition (capabilities `edit_transcribe`). Without it the server answers 503 with the detail
"Speech recognition is not available on this server: send the transcript to /v2/edit/align instead".

post.summary: FuseAlign forced alignment of the audio to a text
Edit recorded speech so it says target_text
post.description:
Regions come from `spans` ([start, end] seconds) when given, otherwise from a word diff between
`original_text` (Qwen3-ASR recognition when omitted) and `target_text` over a FuseAlign alignment. Each region is one
span-end-terminated generation; unedited codec frames are kept exactly. A server without speech recognition
(capabilities `edit_transcribe` false) needs `original_text` whenever the clip's words are read (no `spans`, or a
clip longer than `max_context_seconds`) and refuses `verify`: 503 "Speech recognition is not available on this
server: ..." (the detail names the fix), before any generation.

get.summary: Studio projects stored on the server
get.description: Sorted by `updated_at` descending, then `id`. 404 when server-side projects are disabled.

parameters.name: min_age_seconds
parameters.description: Only blobs whose last write is older than this are removed.

put.description:
`base_revision` must equal the stored revision (null for a new project), else 409 with the stored
`revision`. Every `data.media` key must be uploaded first (else 400 with `missing`).

get.description:
`ETag: "<sha256>"`; an `If-None-Match` naming the hash answers 304. `Cache-Control: public,
max-age=31536000, immutable` (`private, ...` with an access token).

200.description: The blob, with its stored media type.

head.summary: Whether a media blob is stored

put.summary: Upload a media blob addressed by its SHA-256

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Media type to store (default the request's Content-Type).

200.description: Already stored (the body is not read).

Keepalive.name: X-Keepalive
Keepalive.description: `1`: answer 200 at once and send a space every 10 s until the JSON body (errors as `{detail, status_code}`).

NotFound.description: Unknown resource, or a feature this server does not serve.

TooLarge.description: The upload exceeds the server's limit.

Unprocessable.description: The request does not match its schema.

ServerError.description: The request failed inside the server.

Unavailable.description:
A helper worker (Qwen3-ASR, FuseAlign, a plugin's worker, the ggml server's Python host) is unavailable, or the
request needs speech recognition on a server without it (detail "Speech recognition is not available on this
server: " followed by the fix, e.g. "send the clip's transcript as original_text").

missing.description: PUT /v2/projects: media hashes not uploaded yet.

revision.description: 409: the stored revision (null when the project does not exist).

sha256.description: PUT /v2/media: the hash of the content actually sent.

root.description: The served checkpoint's base name (its directory or GGUF file name).

ControlSpan.description: Hidden-space controls over the characters [start, end) of the request's text.

ConditionBuckets.description:
Condition-row bucket ids per name (`loudness`, `fmax`, `speaking_rate`: 0..n-1 with n =
condition_tokens.bucket_counts[name], null = unknown) as an object, or a list in the checkpoint's order.
Refused (400) on checkpoints without condition rows.

ConditionValues.description:
Raw condition values (LUFS / Hz / UTF-8 bytes per second) mapped through the checkpoint's edges; bucket ids
in `condition_buckets` win per name.

GenerationOptions.description: The generation fields shared by GenerateRequest and SpeechRequest.

silence_prefill_frames.description: Codec-matched silence frames prefilled into the audio stream (null = the server default; 0 = off).

decode_context.description: Decode the generated frames behind the last decode_context_frames of the reference prompt.

seed.description: Sampling seed (null = drawn by the server; echoed in X-Seed).

stream_decode.description: Streaming decode: `prefix` streams chunks of an incremental decode as frames arrive, `whole` sends one exact chunk at EOS (null = the server default).

stream_codebooks.description: Prefix decode: decode a frame once this many of its codebooks arrived (codebook j of frame f arrives with row f + j), the missing residual codebooks left out (a coarser RVQ decode, the frame never re-decoded); first audio comes up to n_codebooks - 1 rows earlier. n_codebooks = complete frames only; above it: 400. Default: the generation registry's `stream_codebooks.default`.

stream_codebooks_scope.description: Which prefix chunks `stream_codebooks` applies to: the `first` only (later chunks wait for complete frames), or `all`. Default: the generation registry's `stream_codebooks.scope`.

speaker_mode.description: Speaker path on checkpoints that carry both (null = the checkpoint default).

headroom_db.description: Output gain -headroom_db (null = the decoder's registry value).

speaker_audio_base64.description: A reference clip (any container ffmpeg reads; data URLs accepted).

speaker_reference_codes.description: Pre-encoded reference prefix codes [[cb0..cbN], ...] for raw-reference checkpoints.

speaker_blend_t.description: Slerp position between blend voices a (0) and b (1).

controls_cfg_scale.description: Guidance on the hidden-space delta of `controls` / `control_spans`: the twin is the same prompt without it, uncond + scale * (cond - uncond) (1 = off; needs speaker_mode=embedding).

speaker_cfg_scale.description: Reference CFG: uncond + scale * (cond - uncond) (1 = off).

tag_cfg_scale.description: Tagged-vs-plain guidance on nonverbal markup (1 = off).

control_span_rate.description: Frames per character of the rate schedule (null = 1.0).

control_span_follow.description: `reading` makes the spans follow the alignment heads' reading position.

laci.description: Guard against skips, hallucinations and truncation (servers with LACI heads).

voice.description: A speaker id of GET /v2/speakers (used as speaker_embedding_id).

speaker_modes.description: The speaker modes this voice supports (an embedding voice supports `embedding` only).

disabled_controls.description: Control ids (`<set>.<direction>`, or `<set>.<direction>-` for the negative pole alone) whose set calibration gives this voice dose 0 (the UI greys them out).

TextTokenizerSpec.description: The checkpoint's text tokenizer (SuperBPE), with its extra rows when it has any.

trained.description: The checkpoint was trained on nonverbal markup.

Decoder.description: The audio decoder behind the matched codec (null when the codec has none).

ConditionTokens.description: The checkpoint's condition rows (null when it has none).

bucket_counts.description: Buckets per condition name (ids 0..n-1; n = unknown)

unknown_ids.description: The unknown id per condition name (= its bucket count)

accents.description: Accent adapters a request can pick with `accent`.

plugins.description: Server plugins mounted with --plugins; plugin N serves /v2/N/* and /N (its own spec).

speech_editing.description: The checkpoint edits speech (span-end and marker rows) and the server has FuseAlign and the reference encoder: /v2/edit/align and /v2/edit with the clip's transcript. Speech recognition is not required (edit_transcribe).

edit_transcribe.description: The server also has speech recognition (Qwen3-ASR): /v2/edit/transcribe, /v2/edit without original_text and verify. Always false when speech_editing is false; without it those answer 503.

edit_align_max_seconds.description: The longest clip /v2/edit/align and the alignment inside /v2/edit accept (seconds).

source_index.description: The Full AttnRes bank source a hidden-space set steers.

ControlCalibration.description: The set's calibration.json: per-direction doses chosen offline, keyed by direction name (a `<name>-` key: the negative pole's own dose). Controls stay raw doses; a client scales its sliders by these. Absent when the set has no calibration.

by_speaker.description: Per speaker id overrides of `default`; dose 0 disables the direction for that voice.

global_default.description: The dose of a direction neither `by_speaker` nor `default` names.

ui.description: The bundle's studio UI metadata, passed through.

EditWordIn.description: One word of the original with its timing (seconds), as /v2/edit/align returns it.

EditWord.description:
One aligned word: a whitespace word of the text (one character or Latin run in ja/cmn), its FuseAlign
interval in seconds (a word FuseAlign did not place keeps its fallback interval; an overlap with the previous
word is split at its midpoint), `confidence` = FuseAlign's presence probability, and `tokens` = its edit
tokens (upper-cased; letters, digits and `'` of any script kept, everything else a word break). Punctuation-only
words are left out.

language.description: The audio's language (server code): the Qwen3-ASR recognition language and FuseAlign's tokenization.

original_text.description: The clip's transcript. Omitted, it is recognized with Qwen3-ASR when the clip's words are needed; a server without speech recognition (edit_transcribe false) then answers 503.

original_words.description: Checked word timings of original_text, used instead of the server's alignment.

speaker_embedding.description: Embed the original clip into the speaker row (null = on when the checkpoint has the row).

region_controls.description: One entry per `spans` entry; region k uses controls + region_controls[k].

verify.description: Transcribe each take with Qwen3-ASR and report WER/CER against target_text and the take's words. Needs edit_transcribe (else 503).

tag_cfg_scale.description: Tag CFG is not offered for edits; only 1.0 is accepted.

groups.description: Per pronunciation group of the target, its IPA and the word heard in its place (present when the target has groups).

stopped.description: Per region, whether its fill ended on the span-end token.

contexts.description: The audio the model saw per window (null when the clip was edited whole).

data.description: The studio document, stored verbatim. `data.media` maps each referenced media hash to {type, size}.

base_revision.description: The revision this save is based on (null for a new project).
